description: Dispatches a structured failure alert to an operations webhook (Slack, PagerDuty, or custom) whenever an adapter call fails after all retries are exhausted. Provides full failure context including adapter name, version, error code, error message, client ID, and timestamp. Non-blocking — pipeline continues to the next step even if alert delivery fails. Critical for SRE on-call workflows and SLA breach detection. Commonly triggered after retry_hook exhausts its attempts, ensuring operations teams are immediately notified of integration failures in production.
use_cases: Notifying SRE on-call when a credit bureau adapter fails permanently
Slack or PagerDuty alert on loan disbursal payment failure
Real-time ops notification for GST or KYC adapter outages
SLA breach alerting when critical adapters go down
Automated ticket creation on repeated adapter failures
when_to_use: Attach to all critical adapters (bureau, KYC, payment, health records) in production to ensure operations teams are alerted on any unrecoverable failure.
trigger_condition: When any adapter call fails after all retries are exhausted (4xx, 5xx, timeout, network error)

input_parameters.description: Name of the adapter that failed
HTTP status or internal fault code
Client ID for which the adapter failed
Destination webhook URL for ops alert
